business_summary:
SAAF Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) consulting services in Japan. 
It operates through Consulting, System Development, Human Resource, Construction and Civil Engineering, and Information Technology segments. It offers business system optimization support, IT governance construction support, project management support, and IT strategy promotion backup services for governments and in private sector; digital services, such as system development, IoT, embedded systems, IT infrastructure construction, nearshore development, etc.; and trains professional human resources, as well as human resource development and temporary staffing services for IT, education, manufacturing, and distribution industries. The company also provides ground guarantee, housing completion guarantee, and housing inspection related services; consulting services related to ground environment, land, buildings, etc.; support services, including investigation, analysis, and quality assurance; and undertakes ground investigation, ground improvement, subsidence correction, retaining wall construction, surveying, solar related, soil investigation, and real estate works. In addition, it develops systems comprising GeoWeb System, which prevents falsification of ground survey results by visualizing underground information through an application that encrypts the data and manages in the cloud; offers ground surveying and housing construction improvement, ground investigation, ground improvement works, and housing construction contracting services; and manufactures and sells exterior and interior wall materials for housing applications. The company was formerly known as ITbook Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SAAF Holdings Co.,Ltd. in September 2024. SAAF Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.
business_summary_ko:

컨설팅, 시스템 개발, 인적 자원, 건설 및 토목 공학, 정보 기술 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 정부 및 민간 부문을 대상으로 비즈니스 시스템 최적화 지원, IT 거버넌스 구축 지원, 프로젝트 관리 지원, IT 전략 추진 백업 서비스를 제공합니다. 시스템 개발, IoT, 임베디드 시스템, IT 인프라 구축, Nearshore 개발 등과 같은 디지털 서비스; IT, 교육, 제조, 유통산업을 위한 전문인력 양성과 인재육성 및 임시 인력 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 회사는 또한 토지 보증, 주택 완성 보증 및 주택 검사 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 지상환경, 토지, 건물 등에 관한 컨설팅 서비스; 조사, 분석, 품질 보증을 포함한 지원 서비스; 지반조사, 지반개량, 지반보정, 옹벽공사, 측량, 태양광 관련, 토양조사, 부동산 공사 등을 수행합니다. 나
